result.instructions: Tools for GitBook, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GitBook data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run gitbook_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gitbook_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gitbook_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. gitbook_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gitbook_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Get the profile of the authenticated GitBook user. GitBook REST: GET /user.

tools.name: gitbook_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the authenticated user belongs to. GitBook REST: GET /orgs.

tools.name: gitbook_list_spaces
tools.title: List spaces
tools.description: List all spaces in an organization. GitBook REST: GET /orgs/{organizationId}/spaces.

tools.name: gitbook_get_space
tools.title: Get space
tools.description: Get full details of a space by its ID. GitBook REST: GET /spaces/{spaceId}.

tools.name: gitbook_list_pages
tools.title: List pages
tools.description: List all pages in a space with their hierarchy and metadata. GitBook REST: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/content/pages.

metadata.description: Include page metadata in the response.

computed.description: Include computed properties in the response.

tools.name: gitbook_get_page
tools.title: Get page
tools.description: Get a single page's content from a space by its page ID. GitBook REST: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/content/page/{pageId}.

tools.name: gitbook_search_space
tools.title: Search space
tools.description: Full-text search across all pages in a space. GitBook REST: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/search.

tools.name: gitbook_search_organization
tools.title: Search organization
tools.description: Search content across an entire organization. GitBook REST: GET /orgs/{organizationId}/search.

tools.name: gitbook_list_collections
tools.title: List collections
tools.description: List all collections in an organization. GitBook REST: GET /orgs/{organizationId}/collections.

tools.name: gitbook_get_collection
tools.title: Get collection
tools.description: Get a collection by its ID. GitBook REST: GET /collections/{collectionId}.

tools.name: gitbook_list_change_requests
tools.title: List change requests
tools.description: List change requests for a space. GitBook REST: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/change-requests.

tools.name: gitbook_list_comments
tools.title: List comments
tools.description: List top-level comments posted on a space. GitBook REST: GET /spaces/{spaceId}/comments.

tools.name: gitbook_create_change_request
tools.title: Create change request
tools.description: Create a new draft change request (branch) in a space. Safe: creates a draft; publishes nothing. GitBook REST: POST /spaces/{spaceId}/change-requests.

subject.description: A title/subject for the change request.

tools.name: gitbook_update_change_request
tools.title: Update change request
tools.description: Update a change request's subject or status. Edits draft metadata only. GitBook REST: PATCH /spaces/{spaceId}/change-requests/{changeRequestId}.

subject.description: A new title/subject for the change request.

status.description: A new status for the change request.
